Information about data on this device

Your account, medicines, doses and inventory are stored on this device. Authentication and password recovery use a simulated source in this version; no recovery emails are sent and there is no cloud synchronization. You can delete your account and its local data from Profile. Reminders depend on permissions and operating system restrictions. Optional CIMA lookup sends the package national code to AEMPS. Camera reading is processed locally; Android uses Google Play services. The Google SDK may send technical usage and performance metrics.
Keep your code outside this device. It allows you to restore access if you forget your password.
Create your first medication to organize its schedule and reminders.
Enough stock until the treatment ends
Not estimable: incomplete schedule or amounts
Add medication in Home to configure its stock.
Estimate based on future doses in the current schedule, without replenishments or skipped doses. Overdue pending doses are excluded. This estimate never deducts stock. Maximum horizon: 365 days.

Count the stock you have now. This becomes the initial count with the current date. Past consumption will not be calculated and already recorded doses will not be deducted. Enter your low stock threshold; 0 only flags empty stock.
Stock is not configured: this dose will be recorded without deducting inventory.
Check the amount, precision, reason and stock configuration. Replenishments must be positive and adjustments must change the balance.
Insufficient stock. Review or replenish stock before confirming; the dose remains pending.
The unit does not match the inventory. Keep its unit or create another medication for a different presentation.
Read a supported code on Spanish packaging or enter its six-digit national code.

Code reading happens on the device. Use good lighting and focus on the package code. Android uses Google Play services and may need an initial module download. You can always enter the national code manually. The Google SDK may send technical usage and performance metrics.
CIMA lookup requires internet. Pressing the button sends AEMPS only the requested national code, without photos, profile, history or serial numbers. Manual medication entry works offline.
Unsupported code. Enter the six-digit national code from the package without its check digit. Not all GTIN or Data Matrix codes allow it to be extracted.
GTIN recognized, but it does not identify a Spanish national code by itself. Check the package and enter its six-digit national code, or create the medicine manually.
Camera permission denied. Enable it in device settings or enter the national code manually.
The camera or scanner is unavailable. On Android check Google Play services. You can continue by entering the national code.
No match found. Check the national code or create the medication manually.
CIMA marks this presentation as not marketed. Review the package match.
Fuente de la información: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios www.aemps.gob.es
Only the name and catalogue reference are prefilled. Review and choose the unit, physical amount per dose, schedule, dates and stock. Package strength is not interpreted as a prescribed dose.
I have checked that the name and presentation match my package.
CIMA could not be reached or returned an invalid response. Check your connection, try later or use manual entry.
Inventory is linked to this medication. Keep its name and reference or create another medication for a different product.
No future doses scheduled; review overdue pending doses separately.
